$schema_notes.purpose: Machine-readable source metadata, generated/maintained separately from the human-edited prose in _sources.md and from the knowledge markdown content itself. This file is what the bot/tooling should treat as the structured source of truth for provenance; _sources.md stays the human-readable version of the same facts.

field_glossary.source_document_name: Original filename/title of the source document.
field_glossary.document_type: One of: manufacturer_ifu, manufacturer_user_manual, artg_certificate, jdhg_user_guide, internal_guidance, internal_training_summary, marketing_collateral, internal_sales_positioning, manifest.
field_glossary.revision_version: Revision/version label as printed on the source document, if any.
field_glossary.document_date: Date printed on/associated with the source document itself (not the curation date).
field_glossary.page_or_section: Page or section within the source this knowledge file corresponds to. 'needs_confirmation' where the knowledge file is a whole-document export and page/section wasn't tracked per-fact.
field_glossary.authority_level: One of: confirmed (manufacturer IFU/user manual or ARTG/regulatory document), supported (approved marketing or internal material, not IFU/regulatory grade), or null for non-content files (e.g. the manifest itself). This is a document-type-level default, not a per-claim override — see known_conflicts for specific facts that need_confirmation regardless of the source's general authority_level.
field_glossary.approval_status: Whether this document has been through a formal JDHG approval workflow. 'needs_confirmation' everywhere in this file — no such workflow/record was available at ingestion time and none should be assumed.
field_glossary.approver_owner: Named individual/role who approved this document for use. 'needs_confirmation' everywhere — not invented.
field_glossary.last_reviewed_date: Date this knowledge file's content was actually reviewed/curated against its source (a real, observed date, distinct from approval_status).
field_glossary.external_use_permission: Whether this document is cleared to quote/share externally (e.g. to a customer) vs. internal-JDHG-only. 'needs_confirmation' everywhere — not invented.
field_glossary.current_or_superseded: One of: current (most recent copy found in the source location as of last_reviewed_date — NOT a confirmation against a formal document-control register), superseded, needs_confirmation.
field_glossary.known_location: Where the source document was found (SharePoint/OneDrive folder path), distinct from secure_document_link.
field_glossary.secure_document_link: Either the string 'needs_confirmation' (no verified shareable link on file — this is the default at ingestion time, since the MCP session URIs used to fetch a document are transient, not stable shareable links), or an array of { name, url } objects — one per physical source document a knowledge file merges (most knowledge files map to a single document; some marketing files merge several PDFs, each contributing its own entry). Populated on 2026-08-12 by re-locating each source document's current canonical copy on the main company SharePoint site (or the original JDSalesMarketingHub-MarketingMaterial site where that's where a document actually lives) and recording its real webUrl — see lib/documentLinks.js for how these are surfaced to reps. Left as 'needs_confirmation' where no canonical shared-library copy could be found (only a personal-OneDrive or draft copy existed), where the correct document was itself ambiguous (e.g. easimove-artg-and-regulatory.md — two ARTG certs exist and only one is confirmed applicable, but that one has no findable link), or where the source isn't a shareable file at all (the manifest, a Teams chat message, an INTERNAL USE ONLY document). A link here points at whatever revision is currently live in SharePoint, which is not always the exact revision the knowledge file's prose was written from — see revision_version/document_date for what the prose reflects, and MARKETING_RESYNC.md for the general re-sync caveat.
field_glossary.known_conflicts: Array of specific facts/claims where sources disagree or a single source is internally ambiguous. Empty array if none identified.
